items.title: Bond yield worries persist as oil edges higher: AlphaCheck
items.summary: Stocks fell on Monday as long-dated bond yields continued to climb amid surging oil prices, raising concerns that the Federal Reserve will need to hike rates at its policy meeting next week.

items.title: Memory Stocks Rally as Goldman Says the Worst May Be Over: SK Hynix Climbs 5%, SanDisk Advances 3%, Micron Gains 2%
items.summary: Goldman Sachs just flipped constructive on memory chips, sending SK Hynix, Micron, and SanDisk higher even as the broader market stumbles, but a major NAND supplier's warning about prices complicates the story.

items.title: Apple, Jersey Mike’s, Casey’s, Meta, ServiceTitan, and More Stocks That Explain Today’s Market
items.summary: Investors will be watching for whether Apple’s iPhone event on Wednesday serves as a catalyst for the broader market.  Apple  rose 0.3% with the tech giant expected to unveil a foldable iPhone, which will mark the device’s biggest design change since it debuted in 2007.  CEO John Ternus will host the event, his first since Tim Cook’s departure.
